_meta.purpose: Tennessee-specific licensing and subsidy figures the engine depends on. Same convention as the retirement calculator's tax-tables.json: every number here is VERIFIED against a primary source and cited, or explicitly marked unverified.

sources.title: Rules of the Tennessee Department of Human Services — Licensure Rules for Child Care Agencies, Chapter 1240-04-01
sources.note: Ratios/group sizes read from Rule 1240-04-01-.22(1)(c), Charts 1 and 2, verified in raw page order (pages 82-83).

sources.title: Child Care Certificate Program Provider Weekly Reimbursement Rates Including QRIS Scorecard Bonus Payments

unverifiedItems: Nothing in this file is a guess. Figures NOT yet sourced (and therefore absent rather than estimated): TN employer SUTA rate/wage base for a new nonprofit employer, licensing fee schedule beyond the plan document's stated $879, and CACFP food-program reimbursement rates.

ratios._note: adult:child ratio expressed as childrenPerAdult. maxGroupSize null = no maximum. Rule 1240-04-01-.22(1)(c).
ratios._variance: Rule .22(1)(b)1 permits exceeding ratio and group size by up to 10% (rounded to nearest whole number) no more than 3 days/week, never exceeding licensed capacity, and NEVER for infant or toddler groups. Not modeled by default — it is an exception, not a planning basis.
ratios._secondAdultRule: Rule .22(1)(b)2: when more than 12 children are present on the premises, a second adult shall be physically available. This binds at launch enrollment (12-14) independent of ratio.

chart3_combinedFirstLastHour._note: Rule .22(1)(c)3 — allowable ONLY for the first and last hour and a half of each day. Relevant to opening/closing staffing cost, not to the core ratio requirement.

dhsCertificate._note: Child Care Certificate Program (Smart Steps) provider reimbursement. Rates are WEEKLY and full-time. Part-time is one-half the full-time rate, rounded up.

countyTier._note: 'Top Tier' counties are the 20 highest average population in 2023 and/or 20 highest per-capita income in 2023.

qrisBonus._note: QRIS Scorecard bonus for TDHS Licensed Providers, applied on top of the state rate.

differentials._note: Applied above the current reimbursement rate.
differentials._eliminated: Effective 2025-10-01, differentials for TODDLERS, for child care deserts / distressed counties, and for non-traditional-hour care were eliminated. Do not model them.

ageBandBoundaryMonths._note: IMPORTANT: DHS reimbursement age bands do NOT line up with the program's own room age bands. DHS 'toddler' ends and 'preschool' begins at 31 months, mid-way through the program's 2-3 year old toddler room.

derived._note: Convenience figures computed from the verified numbers above; recomputed in tests, stored here only for reference. Monthly = weekly * 52 / 12.
